opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs) and exempt/excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts. No specific income threshold for regular grants.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round regular grants for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities. Applications are submitted via the online grants portal with no deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, exempt/excepted charities with annual income over £1 million, or projects/capital costs over £1 million. Must have audited/examined accounts and meet other standard eligibility criteria.
opportunities.summary: Major grants for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities. Applications are made via an Expression of Interest submitted year‑round; reviewed on a rolling basis and considered at one of eight Board meetings per year.
